reason: A DSH settings panel for browsing, searching, filtering, comparing, and tracking GitHub-hosted DSH plugins, with metadata refresh and install-entry bookkeeping.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供可浏览、搜索、筛选和比较 GitHub 插件的目录面板，并记录插件管理条目与安装状态。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings panel for browsing, searching, filtering, and comparing GitHub plugins while recording plugin management entries and installation status.

capabilities: Displays a searchable and filterable plugin directory in the DSH settings UI
Fetches plugin metadata from a bundled snapshot, GitHub CDN, and GitHub Search API
Records manually added or install-triggered plugin entries in a host-side data file
Reads plugin inventory status through the DSH plugin inventory remote
